attempt: Built the unmodified authors' sources with make genus F90=gfortran. The Makefile sets F90 = nagfor and no nagfor or ifort exists in the sandbox; the command-line override names gfortran and the authors' own rules and flags (-c -O3, link -O3) build the program. Manifests pre, mid and post are identical (no source file or Makefile changed), so this is build-only. Faces, edges and vertices are observed extras, not claimed values.
